_about: Synthetic Slack history for the GitMore Demo workspace. Authors are handles from people.json. 'date' is the intended date (stored in Slack message metadata, since the API can't backdate). 'reply_to' makes a message a thread reply. Traps are marked in 'note' and are not posted.

messages.author: hannah.lindqvist
messages.text: Welcome to our new joiners this month: Grace (Sales Development) and Kwame (Plan)! Your onboarding buddy will reach out today. The onboarding page has everything: https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/general-onboarding/

messages.author: lena.fischer
messages.text: Quick question: how much notice do I need to give for PTO? Planning 3 days off next week.

messages.author: priya.sharma
messages.text: For anything under 5 days you don't need formal notice, just tell your manager and add it to Workday. Only longer breaks need two weeks' notice.
messages.note: TRAP (outdated): the handbook's PTO page (updated 2026-09-13) now requires at least twice as many days' notice as the time off. GitMore should prefer the newer handbook and flag the conflict.

messages.author: marcus.bennett
messages.text: Reminder: Family and Friends Day is coming up. The whole company is off, so no meetings that day. Details: https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/family-and-friends-day/

messages.author: carlos.mendes
messages.text: Total Rewards update: the Growth and Development Fund request form moved into Workday. Same eligibility as before, see https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/

messages.author: aiko.tanaka
messages.text: Does anyone know if a standing desk counts as home office equipment we can expense?

messages.author: carlos.mendes
messages.text: Yes, office furniture is on the approved home office list, within the limits in the expense policy: https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/

messages.author: lena.fischer
messages.text: The deploy pipeline to staging has been flaky all morning, the QA job keeps timing out. Anyone seen this?

messages.author: arjun.mehta
messages.text: Yes, it's the runner pool for the QA stage, it's undersized after last week's change. I opened engineering#1 and bumped the timeout as a stopgap. Real fix is splitting the QA job, I'll pair with Daniel on it.

messages.author: daniel.kim
messages.text: Confirmed on the infra side, the pool was scaled down by mistake. Scaled back up. Arjun and I will do the job split this week.

messages.author: kwame.mensah
messages.text: New here: what's the process to get my first MR reviewed? Do I pick reviewers myself?

messages.author: oluwaseun.adeyemi
messages.text: Yes, use reviewer roulette to pick a reviewer, then a maintainer approves and merges. Full guide: https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/workflow/code-review/ Tomás and Aiko on my team are happy to review your first few.

messages.author: rachel.cohen
messages.text: Release manager rotation for the next two monthly releases: Arjun, then Daniel. Arjun owns the release checklist issue, see engineering#4.

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: Heads up: we're adding a new index on the merge request diffs table this Thursday, migrations will run in the maintenance window. Tracking in engineering#5. Ping Sofia or me with questions.

messages.author: sofia.rossi
messages.text: Index is live, query times on the MR page dropped from ~900 ms to ~120 ms on p95.

messages.author: tomas.rivera
messages.text: Shipped the new diff file tree in code review behind a feature flag. Please try it and leave feedback in engineering#6.

messages.author: emily.watson
messages.text: Acme Logistics wants a POC of self-managed with SSO before they sign. Ravi, can you run the technical demo?

messages.author: ravi.kumar
messages.text: Yes, I'll set up the POC environment this week. Logging requirements in sales#1.

messages.author: james.oconnor
messages.text: Q3 closed at 104% of target for Enterprise EMEA. Great work everyone. Q4 pipeline review on Monday.

messages.author: hannah.lindqvist
messages.text: Draft 2027 salary bands are in the people-ops wiki. Please review the engineering bands before Friday; we're aligning them with the latest market data.

messages.author: priya.sharma
messages.text: Reviewed. The Senior Backend Engineer band looks low against the benchmark, I left a comment on the page.

messages.author: carlos.mendes
messages.text: Reminder: two parental leave requests start next month, both are using the standard 16 weeks. Coverage plans are with their managers.

messages.author: nadia.haddad
messages.text: SIRT: a CI job token was found in a public fork's job log. Token revoked at 07:50 UTC. Tracking in security#1 (confidential). Victor, can you check whether it was used?

messages.author: victor.petrov
messages.text: Checked audit logs: no use of the token before revocation. Root cause is a debug flag that printed variables in job logs. Fix is in review.

messages.author: nadia.haddad
messages.text: Phishing campaign targeting team members with fake Workday emails today. Reported 3 so far. Reminder to use /security in Slack to report.

messages.author: marcus.bennett
messages.text: The Q3 team restructuring plan is in the leadership wiki. Please don't share outside this channel until it's announced on Oct 15.

messages.author: rachel.cohen
messages.text: Read it. Delivery gets one more SRE headcount, that matches what we asked for.

messages.author: james.oconnor
messages.text: Reminder: calibration for performance reviews is due by Sept 30. Use the talent assessment guidelines in the handbook.
